answer: Random-Horizon Registration Windows. Each epoch a public randomness beacon publishes a seed; an agent’s registration slot is valid only within a window derived from hash(seed, identity) and expires at the next horizon. Attackers cannot precompute slots before the beacon fires, so mass pre-created identities fall outside their assigned windows and must be re-keyed per epoch. The violet seal on each accepted window binds it to that seed, blocking replay.
